How To Install FIFA 2025 Mod FIFA 14 Apk Obb Data Files 

Carefully follow the steps below with images to guide you to extract and install FIFA 2025 mobile files, this steps supports up to Android 11, for Android 13 above use files app, steps to use that will be provided also. 

Part A: Steps extract and move FIFA 2025 Mod 14 Data files 

  1. Using installed Zarchiver App, open it and locate downloaded FIFA files like in the image below.

  2. Now click on the FIFA 2025 Data file.
  3. From options menu that comes up, “Click Extract Here” as it is in the image below (Which means file will be extracted in the current downloads folder).
  4. Click and Hold on the extracted data file for FIFA 2025 just like in the image below.
  5. From options menu that comes up, click “Copy”.
  6. Immediately click on the name of the folder you are already in, like mine is downloads folder, as you can see the arrow in the image below indicating where you should click.
  7. A drop down menu will appear, then Click Device Storage.
  8. Next you click on Android Folder and continue.
  9. Finally Click on Data Folder and follow step 10.
  10. Click Extract Icon just like in the image below and data file will be copied into data folder successfully.

Part B: How To Extract FIFA 2025 Mod 14 Obb file Into Obb Folder. 

  1. Open installed Zarchiver App and locate Obb FIFA 2025 Mod file and click on it.
  2. Options menu will come up and you’ll click “Extract”.
  3. Then click on the name of the folder you are currently in at the top of Zarchiver app interface just like in the image below.
  4. A drop down menu will appear, then click “Device Storage” and proceed.
  5. Now Click “Android Folder” as it is in the image below.
  6. Click Obb folder and wait.
  7. Finally click “Extract Icon” for file to be extracted immediately.
  8. After successfully extracting all the files above, Then install the FIFA 2025 EA Sports Apk App.
